name: obs-studio-bridge
description: Creator-friendly OBS automation for LIVE setup, screen sharing, media workflows, AI transitions, recording, and troubleshooting.

interface.shortDescription: Set up, control, automate, and troubleshoot OBS using creator goals.
interface.longDescription: A creator-facing OBS assistant that turns goals such as sharing a screen, running an AI transition, preparing a LIVE, playing media, recording moments, and diagnosing stream problems into safe OBS actions. Technical bridge details stay behind the creator experience.
defaultPrompt: Share my Chrome window and keep my camera visible.
Run my three-part AI transition and return to LIVE.
Show me what OBS workflows I can automate.
